Researcher in Data Sciences applied to Mass Spectrometry based Metabolomics with a deep focus on signal processing, data treatment, high-throughput and efficient analytical pipelines.

## Experience

**2022 – now CEA / LI-MS / Odiscé** Researcher in Data Sciences

**2020-2022 CEA / LI-MS / Odiscé** Post-Doc on high-throughput Metabolomics applied to liver failure ([Microb-Predict]( https://microb-predict.eu/)).

**2018-2020 MedDay Pharmaceuticals** Researcher in Metabolomics and Bioinformatic team Leader

**2015-2018 IGEPP (INRAE/Univ. Rennes/AgroCampus Ouest)** PhD Student [Metabolic Dissection of Leaf Senescence and Nutrient Remobilization in Oilseed Rape (Brassica napus)](https://theses.fr/2018NSARC133)
